prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, long straight chocolate brown hair — her body is covered in 5 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 horizontal bands by 4 hazy transition zones centred about 19% of the way down her figure from the top, about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 71% of the way down her figure from the top and about 89% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries anodised titanium in iridescent blue, violet and gold bands, a metallic oxide shimmer. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied 24K gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright gold sheen. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries emerald-green high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 4 is the band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 5 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries applied silver leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright cool silver sheen. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a classical Chinese garden with a stone path, a zigzag bridge with a waist-high rail, a moon gate of standard height and a pavilion, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
